race.description: Go Hire Site Rentals Mdn Plate
race.comment: MALUA BAY (2) is back after a six-month spell. Opened the maiden prep with a close fourth here at this trip then bumped into Tron Bolt at Rosehill and wasn't disgraced. Three recent trials have been very good - he looks ready for a strong return. ULTIMATE WARRIOR (8) returns for a second campaign. Showed glimpses of ability at his first two outings. Two solid trials in November are positive signs. REMEMBER THE TIME (4) backs up quickly after making a sound return at Newcastle. Gets in light after the 3kg claim and has upside second-up. ZOUDAWNIE (14) returns and strips fitter for a Hawkesbury 1000m trial. Draws cosy and is worth some thought.
